name: cache-key-classification-folding
body: The classification config is folded into the scan cache key. `requirements.requirement.classification-config-in-cache-key` drives `domain.value.cache-key` and the narrow entity `domain.entity.classification-config`, which is `realised-by` the narrow component `solution.component.cache-classification-key`. That component is `implemented-by` `rust.apg.cache.manifest.ScanConfigKey`, `rust.apg.cache.manifest.CacheKey.compute`, and `rust.apg.scan.cmd_scan`. The classification helpers `rust.apg.cache.manifest.classification_digest` and `rust.apg.cache.manifest.classification_render` are reached through `rust.apg.scan.cmd_scan`; the unit test `rust.apg.cache.tests.unit.cache_key_folds_the_classification_config` exercises the folding.
